TopAppBar.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Top app bar.

Surface container; `small` is a 64dp row with a TitleLarge title, `medium` /
`large` are the Expressive flexible bars — a 64dp row for the icons plus a
second row holding a HeadlineMedium / DisplaySmall title (up to two lines),
112 / 120dp tall (136 / 152dp with a `subtitle`), the title's last baseline
24 / 28dp above the bottom edge. OnSurface title / nav icon, OnSurfaceVariant
subtitle / actions; icon buttons laid out in 48dp slots with no gaps (icons
16dp from the edges); title at 16dp, or 56dp after a nav icon — per
m3.material.io / Compose `AppBar.kt` (`TopAppBar`, `MediumFlexibleTopAppBar`,
`LargeFlexibleTopAppBar`). Standard `IconButton`s in the slots pick up the
slot color.

`search` is the Expressive search app bar (m3 / Compose `AppBarWithSearch`):
a 64dp row — 4dp padding, nav icon, 8dp, the `searchBar` field (56dp,
surface-container), 8dp, actions, 4dp — with on-surface-variant icons.
Scrolled: the bar turns surface-container and the field
surface-container-highest.

Scrolling (docs/decisions/phase-b-api.md B25): the state props (`scrolled`,
`collapsedFraction`, `hidden`) render any state; `scrollBehavior` +
`scrollTarget` derive them from a scroll container like Compose's pinned /
enterAlways / exitUntilCollapsed behaviors. On scroll the container turns
surface-container — a color change only, no shadow.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing action controls.

props.name: collapsedFraction
props.description:
State (medium / large): how far the bar is collapsed toward its 64dp row,
from 0 (expanded) to 1 (collapsed); the container color follows it.
Overrides the value derived from `scrollBehavior`.

props.name: hidden
props.description:
State: slides the whole bar out of view (upward) and takes it out of the
focus order / accessibility tree (`inert`). Unlike the native `hidden`
attribute the bar keeps its layout box. Overrides `scrollBehavior`.

props.name: navigationIcon
props.description: Leading navigation control (e.g. a back or menu IconButton).

props.name: scrollBehavior
props.description:
Observe `scrollTarget` and drive the state above automatically. The bar
then becomes `position: sticky; top: 0` (override with `style` /
`className`) and is meant to sit at the top of the scrolling content.
Leave it unset (and use the state props, or nothing) to keep the bar
fully expanded and reachable — e.g. for assistive-technology users.
Motion is instant under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

props.name: scrolled
props.description:
State: content is scrolled under the bar → the container turns
surface-container (color only, no shadow). Overrides the value derived
from `scrollBehavior`.

props.name: scrollTarget
props.description:
The scroll container observed by `scrollBehavior` (a ref, an element or
the window).

props.name: searchBar
props.description:
`variant="search"`: the search field — typically a `<SearchBar>`. It
replaces the heading text and fills the space between the navigation
icon and the actions (100% of it up to 312dp, then 50% — m3 search app
bar; max 720dp), on a surface-container field that turns
surface-container-highest when `scrolled`. Icons inside the field use
SearchBar's `startIcon` / `endIcon` (`startIcon={false}` for none);
opening the search view is SearchBar's `open` / `onOpenChange`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description:
Supporting text under the title (on-surface-variant; LabelMedium on
`small`, LabelLarge on `medium`, TitleMedium on `large`). Not rendered on
`variant="search"`.

props.name: title
props.description:
The bar title (rendered as the page heading). On `variant="search"` the
search field replaces the visible heading: a given `title` is rendered as
a visually hidden `<h1>` (the page heading for assistive technology).

props.name: titleAlignment
props.description:
Title alignment, available on every size. A centered title is centered
across the full bar width and only pushed inward when it would collide
with the navigation icon or the actions. On `variant="search"` it
centers the search field's text and placeholder.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Size / layout. `medium` / `large` are the M3 Expressive flexible bars,
`search` the search app bar (needs `searchBar`).
`'center'` is deprecated — use `titleAlignment="center"`.

BottomAppBar.description:
Material Design 3 Bottom app bar.

80dp SurfaceContainer bar hosting action icons (OnSurfaceVariant) at the
start (48dp slots, no gaps) and an optional FAB at the end, per Compose
BottomAppBarTokens.

For new designs prefer `<Toolbar variant="docked">`: m3.material.io lists the
bottom app bar as "not recommended — use the docked toolbar" (Compose keeps
`BottomAppBar` non-deprecated, so it stays available here).

props.name: children
props.description: Action controls (icon buttons).

props.name: floatingActionButton
props.description: Optional trailing floating action button.

Autocomplete.description:
Material Design 3 Autocomplete — the editable exposed dropdown menu
(Compose `ExposedDropdownMenuBox` + an editable `TextField` with the
`PrimaryEditable` anchor and a `SecondaryEditable` trailing icon, as in
`EditableExposedDropdownMenuSample`). m3 menus guidelines: "A menu can
include a text field to filter options. This pattern is also known as
autocomplete."

The field is the `TextField` anatomy with a real text `<input>`; typing
filters the listbox, which is the one `Select` uses (top layer, field
width, Expressive options with a check on the selected one). Options that
stay ease into their new position as the list is filtered (DefaultSpatial;
none under reduced motion).

Accessibility follows the WAI-ARIA APG editable combobox with list
autocomplete: the input is `role="combobox"` with `aria-autocomplete="list"`
and keeps focus while the listbox is open; the active option is exposed
through `aria-activedescendant`. ArrowDown / ArrowUp open and move (wrapping),
Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving, Enter picks the active option (or
commits the text with `freeSolo`), Escape closes the listbox (consumed, so an
enclosing Dialog stays open) and, when it is already closed, clears the field
with `clearOnEscape` — else it is left to enclosing handlers. Typing opens the listbox without
activating an option. The trailing arrow is a button (`tabindex="-1"`) that
toggles the listbox.

A visually hidden native `<input>` carries `name` / `value` for form
submission, `required` validation, and form reset.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the input on mount.

props.name: children
props.description: `Option` elements (direct children or inside Fragments), used when `options` is not given.

props.name: clearOnEscape
props.description:
Escape with the listbox closed clears the input and the value (and is
consumed). Without it, that Escape does nothing and reaches enclosing
handlers — an enclosing Dialog closes. Escape with the listbox open only
closes the listbox either way.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description:
Uncontrolled initial text of the input. Defaults to the label of
`defaultValue` (or `defaultValue` itself with `freeSolo`).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field (and leaves the value out of form submission).

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — error colors, `aria-invalid`, and `errorText`. Ignored while `disabled`.

props.name: errorText
props.description:
Shown instead of `supportingText` (with `role="alert"`) when `error` is set.
Accepts rich content, like `supportingText`.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description:
Custom filtering. Receives every option and `{ inputValue }`; returns the
options to show, in order. The default keeps the options whose label
contains the text, ignoring case and accents.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the hidden native input with a `<form>` elsewhere in the page (native `form` attribute).

props.name: freeSolo
props.description:
Accept any text, not only an option: Enter (with no option active) or
leaving the field commits the typed text as the value. Without it, the
text returns to the selected option's label on blur.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the field (and therefore the listbox) to the container's width.

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the `role="combobox"` `<input>`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the `role="combobox"` text `<input>` (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled text of the input.

props.name: label
props.description:
Floating label; also names the input and the listbox. Rendered with a trailing `*` when `required`.

Accepts rich content (text, emphasis, a small icon) — keep it short and
on one line, as m3 asks: the label is a single line (truncated with an
ellipsis), clicks on it go to the field, and the outlined notch draws a
hidden copy of it to measure its width. So no links or buttons in the
label, and no elements with an `id`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of the hidden native input that carries the value.

props.name: noOptionsText
props.description:
Shown in the listbox when no option matches. Without it the listbox
closes instead (Compose `EditableExposedDropdownMenuSample`).

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires when the value changes: an option is picked, the input is cleared
(or Escape clears it, with `clearOnEscape`), or — with `freeSolo` — typed text is committed with
Enter or on blur. Not fired on form reset.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Fires on every change of the input text: typing, picking an option, clearing, and the reset on blur.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the listbox should open or close.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the listbox.

props.name: options
props.description: The options, as strings or `{ value, label, disabled }` objects. Use `Option` children instead for icons.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the input (shown once the label has floated, or always without a label).

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a value for form submission (native constraint validation) and appends `*` to the label.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the field (decorative).

props.name: supportingText
props.description:
Helper line below the field. Replaced by `errorText` while in error.
Accepts rich content — a short link is fine (it stays reachable and is
part of the field's description via `aria-describedby`); keep it to
about one line, as m3 asks.

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the trailing toggle button (Compose
`Strings.ToggleDropdownMenu`).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (`''` = nothing selected; with `freeSolo`, any text).

props.name: variant
props.description: Text field container style (the same two as `TextField`).

Option.description:
An option of a `Select` or `Autocomplete` (`role="option"`). The selected
option shows the tertiary-container colors, a 12dp corner shape and a
leading check mark.

props.name: children
props.description: The option's label. Also what the field shows once it is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Visible, inert, and skipped by keyboard navigation.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the option (decorative); the check mark replaces it while selected.

props.name: textValue
props.description:
Plain-text label for an `Autocomplete`: the text the input shows once the
option is picked and the text filtering matches. Defaults to the text
content of `children`. Ignored by `Select`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this option selects (submitted with the form).

props.name: children
props.description: Content the badge is attached to (e.g. an icon).

props.name: label
props.defaultValue: "New notification" for a dot, "{n} new notifications" for a count
props.description:
Accessible description announced for the badge (rendered as visually
hidden text right after the anchor content; the visible digits are
hidden from assistive technology). Override it to localize, or set
`LocaleProvider` `labels.Badge.getLabel` for every badge.

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum value. Values above this show `{max}+`. Keep it at 999 or below —
MD3 limits a badge to four characters including the `+`.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size. `"small"` renders a dot; `"large"` renders a label.

props.name: value
props.description: Number to display inside the badge. Ignored when `size="small"`.

props.name: visible
props.description:
Whether the badge is visible. A hidden badge scales out and is then
removed from the accessibility tree as well.

BadgeLabelText.description:
The default announced text of a Badge — LocaleProvider
`labels.Badge.getLabel` (Phase B B50), else the English B28 wording. The
one client part of the otherwise server-safe Badge (#409): it is the only
piece that reads the locale context, and it takes only serializable props.

BottomSheet.description:
Material Design 3 bottom sheet (modal or standard).

SurfaceContainerLow container, 28dp top corners, elevation 1, max-width
640dp, an OnSurfaceVariant 32×4 drag handle — per Compose SheetBottomTokens.
The modal variant slides up over a 0.32 Scrim (`role="dialog"
aria-modal`); the standard variant is a labelled `region` without a scrim.
Escape closes either (the standard one while focus is inside it).

By default the sheet opens at full height and the drag handle is a close
button. With `skipPartiallyExpanded={false}` (Compose `SheetValue`
detents) it opens partially expanded — showing
`min(container / 2, sheet / 2)` — and the handle toggles partial /
expanded (`aria-expanded`).
Dragging snaps between hidden, partial and expanded: past 56px from the
starting detent, or a fling faster than 125px/s, moves to the next detent
(Compose thresholds); reaching hidden calls `onClose(event, 'drag')`.

A modal sheet mounted with `open` slides in like one opened later. Initial
focus (modal): an element React's `autoFocus` focused inside it, else the
element marked `data-autofocus`, else the first tabbable element.
`autoFocus` only runs when its element mounts, so for content rendered
while the sheet is closed mark the target with `data-autofocus` instead.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description:
Uncontrolled initial detent. An uncontrolled sheet returns to it each
time it closes, so it reopens partially expanded (Compose
`SheetState.show()`).

props.name: dragHandleLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the drag handle button.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Whether the open sheet is fully expanded (`true`) or partially expanded
(`false`: half of its height, at most half of the container). Controlled.
Only used with `skipPartiallyExpanded={false}`.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called on scrim click, Escape, a drag / fling to the hidden position,
or the drag handle (unless partially expanding is enabled), with the triggering
event and the `reason`.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when a drag or the drag handle moves the sheet between detents.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is shown.

props.name: showDragHandle
props.description: Show the top drag handle.

props.name: skipPartiallyExpanded
props.description:
Skip the partially-expanded detent: the sheet always opens fully
expanded and the drag handle dismisses it. Pass `false` to opt in to
Compose's current behavior — open partially expanded, with the handle
toggling partial / expanded (ruling B35: the default may flip in v2).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`'modal'` overlays the page with a scrim, traps focus and inerts the
rest of the page (Compose `ModalBottomSheet`). `'standard'` co-exists
with the page — no scrim, no focus trap, no inert, no scroll lock — and
is positioned at the bottom of its nearest positioned ancestor
(Compose `BottomSheet` / `BottomSheetScaffold`).

Button.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Button.

A native `<button>` — activation, keyboard, and `onClick` are standard DOM
behavior (MUI-idiomatic). The MD3 state layer, press ripple, and focus ring
come from the shared primitives; the corner morphs to a tighter shape while
pressed via CSS `:active` (Expressive). Set `toggle` for a selectable button
(`aria-pressed`); the `text` variant has no toggle styling.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Trailing icon (decorative).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selected state when toggled.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: shape
props.description: Resting shape; both shapes morph to a tighter corner while pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

props.name: toggle
props.description:
Enable toggle (selectable) behavior with `aria-pressed` (Expressive).
Inside a `ButtonGroup` with `selectionMode`, give the button a `value`
instead — the group then owns its selection.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis.

ButtonGroup.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Button group — an invisible container that adds
padding between buttons and modifies their shape.

`standard` spaces buttons by the size's between-space (18 / 12 / 8 / 8 / 8dp
for xs–xl); pressing a button widens it by 15% and narrows its neighbours
(Compose `animateWidth`). `connected` joins buttons with a 2dp gap, keeps the
outer corners fully round, gives the inner corners a per-size radius that
tightens while pressed, and fully rounds a selected (toggle) button. Wraps
`Button` / `IconButton` children — it has no color of its own.

Selection (Expressive "single-select / multi-select / selection-required"):
set `selectionMode` and give each child a `value`; the group owns the state
via `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(event, value)`. `single` exposes a
radiogroup (one Tab stop, arrow keys move and select); `multiple` exposes
toggle buttons. A connected single-select group replaces the baseline
segmented button.

Keyboard: arrow keys move focus between the buttons (Left / Right when
horizontal — mirrored in RTL — Up / Down when vertical; a radiogroup accepts
both), Home / End jump to the ends, disabled buttons are skipped.

props.name: children
props.description:
`Button` / `IconButton` children (give them a `value` when the group has
a `selectionMode`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.type: string | number | readonly string[] | string[] | null
props.description:
Unused without a selection model (kept for HTMLAttributes compatibility).
Uncontrolled initial selected item value.
Uncontrolled initial selected item values.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disable every `Button` / `IconButton` in the group (MUI
`ToggleButtonGroup` parity); an item's own `disabled` still applies.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ChangeEventHandler<HTMLDivElement, Element> | ((event: SyntheticEvent<Element, Event>, value: string | null) => void) | ((event: SyntheticEvent<...>, value: string[]) => void)
props.description:
Native `change` events bubbling from descendants.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected value.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected values.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction.

props.name: selectionRequired
props.description:
Keep one item selected: re-activating the selected item does nothing.
Keep at least one item selected.

props.name: size
props.description:
Match the child button size: sets the between-space (standard) or the
inner corners and 48dp minimum width (connected).

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected item value (`null` = none).
Controlled selected item values.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`standard` spaces buttons and widens the pressed one; `connected` joins
them into a single shape with small inner corners.

Card.description:
Material Design 3 Card.

A container with the three MD3 styles (filled / elevated / outlined),
corner-medium (12dp) shape.

- **Static** (default): a `<div>`; compose actions inside with
  `CardActionArea` (the primary action — a button or link wrapping the
  content) and `CardActions` (a row of buttons beside it).
- **`onClick`**: the whole card is one button (`role="button"`, Enter /
  Space, ripple, focus ring, state elevation).
- **`href`**: the whole card is one link (`<a>`, Enter only).

A clickable / link card must not contain other interactive elements (a
development warning points to `CardActionArea` + `CardActions`).

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Show the disabled appearance (container and content at 38%). A clickable
or link card also stops responding (`aria-disabled`, removed from the Tab
order).

props.name: download
props.description: `<a download>` — only with `href`.

props.name: dragged
props.description:
Apply the MD3 dragged appearance — raised elevation (filled / outlined
6dp, elevated 8dp) and the 0.16 on-surface state layer — for
drag-and-drop. Works on static and clickable cards.

props.name: href
props.description:
Make the surface a link: renders an `<a href>` (Enter activates; middle
click, open-in-new-tab and the status-bar URL work natively).

props.name: target
props.description: `<a target>` — only with `href`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container style.

CardActionArea.description:
The primary action of a static `Card` (MUI `CardActionArea`): wraps the
card's content in one button (`onClick` → `role="button"`, Enter / Space)
or link (`href` → `<a>`, Enter), with the ripple, focus ring and the card's
hover / pressed elevation. Its accessible name comes from its content.
Place other actions in a sibling `CardActions`, never inside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the action (dimmed by the card's `disabled`, not by this prop).

props.name: download
props.description: `<a download>` — only with `href`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Make the surface a link: renders an `<a href>` (Enter activates; middle
click, open-in-new-tab and the status-bar URL work natively).

props.name: target
props.description: `<a target>` — only with `href`.

Carousel.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Carousel.

A horizontally scrolling row of 28dp-rounded items (16dp start / end and 8dp
block padding, 8dp between items — m3.material.io carousel specs).

`multi-browse` and `hero` use Compose's keyline layout: every item is laid
out at the large size and *masked* (clipped, never scaled) to the size of
the keyline it passes, so items grow and shrink between large, medium and
small as they scroll while keeping their full height and 28dp corners.
Where CSS scroll-driven animations are supported the mask is a
compositor-run animation of the scroll position, so it moves in the same
frame as the scroll. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` all items keep
one size (m3 carousel accessibility). `uncontained` items never change size
and scroll freely.

Scrolling: touch, trackpad, Shift + mouse wheel, keyboard and mouse drag
(drag, fling and snap like touch — a drag never activates the item it
started on). A plain vertical wheel keeps scrolling the page. For mouse /
keyboard users on vertically scrolling pages, m3 recommends a "Show all"
control near the carousel rather than arrow buttons.

Give the carousel an `aria-label`. Items are announced as slides with their
position ("2 of 7", see `getItemLabel`). With `onClick` / `href` items, Tab
and Left / Right move between items and a focused item scrolls into the
focal (large) position; otherwise the scroll container itself is focusable.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name of the carousel. Required in practice — the container is a
`group` announced as "carousel".

props.name: children
props.description: `CarouselItem`s.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description:
Accessible label of each item's position, announced with the item
(non-interactive items: the slide's name; `onClick` / `href` items: its
description). `position` is 1-based.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Item height in px.

props.name: itemRoleDescriptionLabel
props.description:
Role description announced for each non-interactive item
(`aria-roledescription`).

props.name: itemWidth
props.defaultValue: 260 (`hero`: fills the container beside its small items)
props.description:
Preferred (large) item width in px — a **target, not a cap** (Compose
`preferredItemWidth`, renamed from `maxItemWidth`). `multi-browse` /
`hero` pick the arrangement whose large items land closest to it and
resize small (40–56dp), then medium, then large items so a whole number
of items fills the container, so the rendered large width can be wider or
narrower than this value. Large items always stay wider than the small
ones, so values at or below the small-item minimum cannot be honored.
`uncontained` uses it as-is.

At the end of the list the arrangement shifts so the last item aligns to
the container's end (`multi-browse`: the large item slides to the end;
`hero`: the first / last item aligns to the start / end instead of
centering). A `hero` carousel with fewer than 3 items cannot center and
stays start-aligned (a large item with one small item; a single item is
just large).

props.name: roleDescriptionLabel
props.description:
Role description announced for the carousel container
(`aria-roledescription`).

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between items in px.

props.name: variant

CarouselItem.description:
A single 28dp-rounded item inside a `Carousel`.

Without `onClick` / `href` it is a non-interactive slide (`role="group"`,
`aria-roledescription="slide"`, named by its position). With `onClick` it
renders a `<button>`, with `href` an `<a>` — focusable, activated with
Enter / Space (links: Enter), with the hover / focus / pressed state layer,
ripple and focus ring; its position becomes the accessible description.
A mouse drag that starts on the item scrolls the carousel instead of
activating it.
Put nested interactive content only in non-interactive items.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable an interactive (`onClick` / `href`) item: dimmed, not focusable.

props.name: download
props.description: Download hint (with `href`).

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the item a link (`<a>`): activated with Enter, opens in new tabs.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship (with `href`).

props.name: target
props.description: Link target (with `href`).

Checkbox.description:
Material Design 3 Checkbox.

Uses a native `<input type="checkbox">` for proper form integration and
accessibility. The visual container, checkmark, and state layer are rendered
via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled initial checked state.

props.name: error
props.description: Error state. Also sets `aria-invalid` on the native input.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Indeterminate (mixed) state.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the next checked state on toggle.

Chip.description:
Material Design 3 Chip.

Supports assist, filter, input, and suggestion variants.
Uses a native `<button>` for the primary action. Filter chips toggle
selection (`aria-pressed`); input chips opt into the same selection API by
passing `selected` / `defaultSelected` / `onChange`. Inside a `ChipSet` with
a `selectionMode`, chips with a `value` are selected by the set (single →
`role="radio"` + `aria-checked`). Removable chips have a trailing remove
button; other filter chips may show a decorative `endIcon` (e.g. a menu
arrow).

Structure mirrors material-web: each action has its own Ripple/FocusRing.
Primary Ripple is scoped to the action button. The trailing remove button
has its own circular 24dp Ripple/FocusRing.

Keyboard: Arrow keys move focus between primary and trailing actions
(matching material-web's multi-action chip pattern); at the boundary they
propagate to an enclosing `ChipSet`. Trailing action is not in the Tab
order; only reachable via arrow keys. Backspace / Delete on a removable
chip calls `onRemove`.

The forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>` (MUI parity); extra props
(`{...rest}`) still land on the primary action `<button>`.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Leading avatar (input chips only) — rendered 24dp and clipped to a circle, e.g. an ``. Takes precedence over `icon`.

ChipSet.description:
Material Design 3 chip set — lays chips out in a wrapping row (8dp apart)
and makes the whole set ONE Tab stop (m3 keyboard table: "Tab moves focus
to the chip group; Arrows move focus between chips").

- Roving tabindex: only the last-focused chip's primary action is tabbable.
- ArrowLeft / ArrowRight (mirrored in RTL) move between chips; inside a
  removable chip they first step between its primary and remove actions.
  Moving backwards into a removable chip lands on its remove action.
- Home / End jump to the first / last chip. Disabled chips are skipped.
- When a focused chip is removed, focus moves to its neighbour.

Renders `role="toolbar"` (APG toolbar pattern, material-web `md-chip-set`)
so chips keep their button semantics and `aria-pressed`. Give it an
accessible name with `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`.

Selection (B36): set `selectionMode` and give each filter / input chip a
`value`; the set owns the state via `value` / `defaultValue` /
`onChange(event, value)` (the ButtonGroup / List shape). `multiple` keeps
the toolbar of `aria-pressed` toggle chips. `single` follows the APG radio
group: `role="radiogroup"`, chips are `role="radio"` + `aria-checked`, the
selected chip is the Tab stop, and the arrow keys (Left / Right / Up /
Down, wrapping) and Home / End move focus AND select.

props.name: children
props.description:
The chips. They may be wrapped in other elements (e.g. a Tooltip or a
Menu). Give filter / input chips a `value` when the set has a
`selectionMode`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.type: string | number | readonly string[] | string[] | null
props.description:
Unused without a selection model (kept for HTMLAttributes compatibility).
Uncontrolled initial selected chip value.
Uncontrolled initial selected chip values.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every chip in the set; a chip's own `disabled` still applies.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ChangeEventHandler<HTMLDivElement, Element> | ((event: SyntheticEvent<Element, Event>, value: string | null) => void) | ((event: SyntheticEvent<...>, value: string[]) => void)
props.description:
Native `change` events bubbling from descendants.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected value.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected values.

props.name: selectionRequired
props.description:
Keep one chip selected: re-activating the selected chip does nothing.
Keep at least one chip selected.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected chip value (`null` = none).
Controlled selected chip values.

Calendar.description:
The month view shared by the modal `DatePicker` and the docked
`DatePickerField`: navigation header, weekday header and a 6×7 day grid,
swapped for the year (and, docked, month) selection menus.

Grid semantics follow the APG date picker dialog and m3 accessibility:
`role="grid"` named by the month, `columnheader`s with the full weekday
name, and day `gridcell`s (native buttons) named with the full date plus
Compose's range/today prefixes, `aria-selected` on the selection and
`aria-current="date"` on today. The grid is a single Tab stop with a roving
tabindex (selected → today → 1st); arrows move by day / week, PageUp/Down by
month, Shift+PageUp/Down by year, Home/End to the first/last day of the
month (m3 key table), and Enter/Space select.

Navigation is bounded by min/max (else Compose's 1900–2100 year range):
arrows, years and months that cannot show a selectable day are disabled,
and keyboard focus is clamped into that range.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus to the roving day cell on mount.

props.name: layout
props.description:
`modal`: month-year menu button + month arrows, year grid.
`docked`: month and year menu buttons each with arrows, list menus,
neighbouring-month days shown at 38%.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: `viaEnter` is true when the day was chosen with the Enter key.

props.name: rangeStart
props.description: Range endpoints (range mode).

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: Day marked as today; defaults to the client's current date.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected date (single mode).

DatePicker.description:
Material Design 3 Date picker (modal calendar, with date input).

SurfaceContainerHigh panel, 28dp corners, 360dp wide, elevation 3. Day cells
are 40dp round; selected fills Primary / OnPrimary, today shows a 1dp Primary
outline. In `range` mode two dates are picked and the span is highlighted with
SecondaryContainer — per Compose DatePickerModalTokens. The day grid is an
APG grid (single Tab stop, arrow / Page / Home / End keys); the month label
is a menu button that swaps the grid for a year picker, and the header's
edit icon switches to text input (m3 "modal date input").

Draft / commit (Phase B B6): `onChange` reports every pick; passing
`onAccept` / `onCancel` adds the Cancel / OK row, and `open` shows the
picker as a modal dialog — no separate `DatePickerDialog`. For the docked
variant use `DatePickerField`.

Built-in strings are English by default and can be replaced through the
`*Label` props, or for the whole app through `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Dismiss button label.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Uncontrolled initial display mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: endDateLabel
props.description: Range end: cell prefix, headline placeholder and input label.

props.name: getErrorLabel
props.description: Input-mode error message. Defaults to Compose's English strings.

props.name: inputLabel
props.description: Label of the single-date text field in input mode.

props.name: inRangeLabel
props.description: Prefix announced on days inside the range.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month / weekday names, the week's first day and the input format.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (inclusive).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive).

props.name: mode
props.description: Controlled display mode (calendar grid or text input).

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the next-month button.

props.name: noSelectionLabel
props.description: Headline shown while no date is selected (single mode).

props.name: okLabel
props.description: Confirm button label.

props.name: onAccept
props.description:
OK / Enter commits the draft. Passing `onAccept`, `onCancel` or `open`
renders the Cancel / OK action row (m3 anatomy; Compose
`DatePickerDialog`). OK is enabled once a date (or a full range) is set.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
Cancel, Escape or a scrim click: the value reverts to what it was when
the picker opened (or was last accepted, or last set from outside) — reported through `onChange`
when it can be expressed (a date, or a range) — and this fires.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the new value (`Date` in single mode, `[start, end]` in range)
on every pick — with the action row this is the draft; `onAccept` commits.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Modal only: the picker asks to close, with the reason (B7 vocabulary).

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Fires when the header toggle switches the display mode.

props.name: open
props.description:
Show the picker as a modal dialog (scrim, focus trap, Escape) — the
Compose `DatePickerDialog` equivalent. Omit for an inline picker.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the previous-month button.

props.name: range
props.description: Select a start/end range instead of a single date.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description:
The date treated as "today": it opens the calendar on its month when no
date is selected and receives the today marker. Defaults to the client's
current date. With server rendering, pass the same date on the server and
the client (e.g. computed once in the user's time zone) so the initially
visible month hydrates identically; without it the today marker appears
only after hydration.

props.name: selectYearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the year picker list.

props.name: showModeToggle
props.description: Show the header's calendar / text-input toggle (m3: date input via the edit icon).

props.name: startDateLabel
props.description: Range start: cell prefix, headline placeholder and input label.

props.name: switchToCalendarLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the toggle while showing the text input.

props.name: switchToInputLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the toggle while showing the calendar.

props.name: titleLabel
