props.description: Header title.

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: Prefix announced on today's cell.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value — a `Date` (single) or `[start, end]` (range).

DatePickerField.description:
Material Design 3 Docked date picker.

An outlined text field (type a date directly) with a trailing calendar
button that opens the calendar in a dropdown — the docked variant per
m3.material.io (16dp corners, a 64dp header with month and year menu
buttons and arrows, neighbouring-month days at 38%). Typed text is parsed on Enter or blur in the locale's field
order (no input mask; `-`, `/`, `.` and spaces all work) and rejected text
shows an error; the helper text states the format.

The popup is a non-modal `role="dialog"`: opening moves focus to the
selected day (else today), Escape or a pick closes it and returns focus to
the toggle, and it closes when focus or a click leaves the field. It is
drawn in the top layer (Popover API) below the field — above it when it
doesn't fit below — and kept inside the viewport.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial date.

props.name: dialogLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar popup (`role="dialog"`).

props.name: getErrorLabel
props.description:
Error message for rejected typed text. Defaults to Compose's English
strings: "Date does not match expected pattern: MM/DD/YYYY" / "Date not
allowed". May return rich content, like `supportingText`.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Extra attributes for the inner text field's native `<input>` (e.g.
`autoFocus`, `aria-*`). Same precedence as TextField `inputProps`: the
field's own wiring wins; an `onKeyDown` runs before the Enter-to-commit
handler.

props.name: inputRef
props.description:
Ref to the inner text field's native `<input>` (the forwarded `ref`
points at the root) — e.g. for React Hook Form `register`.

props.name: label
props.description:
Field label.

Accepts rich content (text, emphasis, a small icon) — keep it short and
on one line, as m3 asks: the label is a single line (truncated with an
ellipsis), clicks on it go to the field, and the outlined notch draws a
hidden copy of it to measure its width. So no links or buttons in the
label, and no elements with an `id`.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Label position, as TextField `labelPlacement`: `'floating'` (in the
outlined border's notch) or `'above'` the field.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale — display format, typed-date field order, week start.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input `name` (the typed date text is what a form submits).

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the next-month button.

props.name: nextYearLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the next-year button.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected / committed typed date (or null when cleared).

props.name: openCalendarLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the calendar toggle.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the previous-month button.

props.name: previousYearLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the previous-year button.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description:
The date treated as "today": it opens the calendar on its month when no
date is selected and receives the today marker. Defaults to the client's
current date. With server rendering, pass the same date on the server and
the client (e.g. computed once in the user's time zone) so the initially
visible month hydrates identically; without it the today marker appears
only after hydration.

props.name: selectMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the month menu list.

props.name: selectYearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the year menu list.

props.name: shrinkLabel
props.description:
Keep the floating label minimized while the field is empty, as
TextField `shrinkLabel`.

props.name: supportingText
props.description:
Helper text under the field. Defaults to the locale's input format
(e.g. `MM/DD/YYYY`), as m3 accessibility asks.
Accepts rich content — a short link is fine (it stays reachable and is
part of the field's description via `aria-describedby`); keep it to
about one line, as m3 asks.

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: Prefix announced on today's cell.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date.

Dialog.description:
Material Design 3 Dialog (basic / alert).

SurfaceContainerHigh container, 28dp corners, elevation 3, 280–560dp wide,
24dp padding; Secondary icon, OnSurface HeadlineSmall title, OnSurfaceVariant
BodyMedium text — per Compose DialogTokens. Modal with a 0.32 Scrim,
role="dialog" aria-modal, and Escape-to-close.

- Long content scrolls inside the body only; the icon, title and actions
  (the full-screen top bar) stay fixed (ruling B46).
- Width: set `--md-dialog-container-min-width` / `--md-dialog-container-max-width`
  (default `280px` / `560px` — the m3 basic dialog range; other values are
  outside the spec) on the dialog (`style` / `className`) or an ancestor.
  Not used by `fullScreen`.
- While open, the dialog is drawn in the browser top layer, above popups
  opened before it, such as the Menu it was opened from (ruling B45).
- Mounted with `open`, it plays the same open motion as opening later.
- Initial focus: an element React's `autoFocus` focused inside it, else
  the element marked `data-autofocus`, else the first tabbable element.
  `autoFocus` only runs when its element mounts, so for content rendered
  while the dialog is closed (the usual `open={open}` pattern) mark the
  target with `data-autofocus` instead.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing action buttons (typically text Buttons).

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting content / body.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the full-screen close button.

props.name: fullScreen
props.description: Full-screen dialog: a top bar (close + title + action) over full-bleed content.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional hero icon (Secondary, 24dp, centers the title).

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called on scrim click, Escape, or the full-screen close button, with the
triggering event and the `reason`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog headline.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Whether the divider is purely decorative. MD3 dividers are decorative
elements (Compose draws them without semantics), so by default the
divider is hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden`). Pass
`decorative={false}` for a meaningful thematic break — it is then
exposed as a separator (the implicit role of `<hr>`; a vertical divider
adds `aria-orientation="vertical"`).

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Orientation. A vertical divider stretches to the height of its flex /
grid row (`align-self: stretch`).

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout variant.

DragHandle.description:
Material Design 3 drag handle for resizing panes (Compose
`VerticalDragHandle`, DragHandle.kt:73).

A vertical capsule placed between two side-by-side panes; dragging it
horizontally (or pressing the arrow keys) changes the size of the pane on
`paneSide`. The host is a focusable WAI-ARIA APG **window splitter**:
`role="separator"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, `aria-valuenow` /
`aria-valuemin` / `aria-valuemax` = `value` / `min` / `max`. Give it an
accessible name that matches the controlled pane (`aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby`) and point `aria-controls` at that pane.

Keys: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move the handle by `step` (`shiftStep` with
Shift), Page Up / Page Down by `shiftStep`, Home / End to `min` / `max`.
ArrowUp / ArrowDown also work (up = grow), as for other range widgets.

Size and state follow `VerticalDragHandleDefaults`: 4×48dp `outline`
capsule at rest; 12×52dp `on-surface` with 12dp corners while pressed or
dragged. The host is 24dp wide (`DragHandleTokens.ContainerWidth`) with a
48dp touch target. The handle only reports sizes; the layout (pane widths)
is the app's.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial size.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging and keyboard resizing and removes the handle from the tab order.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: Human-readable size for assistive tech (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => \`${v} pixels\``.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest size (`aria-valuemax`).

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest size (`aria-valuemin`).

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires while dragging and on each key press, with the triggering event and
the new (clamped) size. Not fired when the size would not change.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.description: Fires when a pointer drag ends (release or cancel), with the final size — e.g. to persist it.

props.name: onDragStart
props.description: Fires when a pointer drag starts (after the first movement), with the size at that point.

props.name: paneSide
props.description:
Which side of the handle the controlled pane is on (logical, so it
mirrors in RTL). `'start'`: dragging toward the inline end grows it (the
list of a list-detail layout); `'end'`: dragging toward the inline start
grows it.

props.name: shiftStep
props.description: Size change per Shift + arrow and Page Up / Page Down.

props.name: step
props.description: Size change per arrow key.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled size of the controlled pane, in px (the separator's
`aria-valuenow`).

Fab.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Floating Action Button.

A native `<button>` (MUI-idiomatic `onClick`) supporting 4 sizes
(small 40dp, regular 56dp, medium 80dp, large 96dp), 3 color sets
(`primary` / `secondary` / `tertiary`, each tonal by default or
high-emphasis via `tonal={false}`), and an optional label for the Extended
FAB. With `expanded` the Extended FAB morphs
between icon-only and icon + label: the label row's measured width
(`--_label-total`) scales with the spring-driven `--_ext` while the label
cross-fades via `--_label-o` — or, with `followContainer`, both follow a
morphing container's inherited `--_t` instead. Elevation lifts on hover
(level 3 → 4); the container shape is static (MD3 / Compose define no
pressed FAB shape).

MD3 advises against disabling a FAB — hide it when its action is
unavailable. The native `disabled` attribute is still honored.

props.name: color
props.description: Color set for the container/content roles.

props.name: disableElevation
props.description:
Removes the container shadow. Per the MD3 spec a FAB inside a Navigation
rail (or drawer) has no elevation.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
For an Extended FAB (with `label`): `true` shows the label, `false`
collapses it to the plain icon-only FAB. Toggling runs the MD3 Expressive
spring morph (Compose `ExtendedFloatingActionButton(expanded=)`).
Omit for a static Extended FAB. Ignored without `label`, and ignored
while `followContainer` drives the morph.

props.name: followContainer
props.description:
Follows the `--_t` morph value inherited from a morphing container
(e.g. a `NavigationRail` header) instead of running the FAB's own
spring, staying exactly in sync with the container's spring. While
`true`, `expanded` is ignored. Requires `label`.

props.name: icon
props.description:
The icon displayed in the FAB. An Extended FAB (with `label`) may pass
`null` for a label-only FAB.

props.name: label
props.description:
Optional label — turns the FAB into an Extended FAB, sized per the MD3
Expressive extended FAB: `regular` → small extended (56dp, title-medium),
`medium` → medium extended (80dp, title-large), `large` → large extended
(96dp, headline-small). There is no 40dp extended FAB — `size="small"`
with a label renders the 56dp small extended FAB.

props.name: size
props.description:
Container size: small 40dp (no longer recommended by MD3 — prefer a larger
size; it keeps a 48dp touch target), regular 56dp, medium 80dp (the size
MD3 recommends most), large 96dp.

props.name: tonal
props.description:
`true` (the default) renders the tonal palette — the `*-container` /
`on-*-container` roles (e.g. `primary-container`). `false` renders the
high-emphasis accent palette — the base color roles (e.g. `primary` with
`on-primary` content).

FabMenu.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) FAB menu.

A FAB (regular / medium / large) that opens into a vertical stack of
labelled action items above it, aligned to its trailing edge by default
(`horizontalAlignment`: `start` / `center` / `end`). The FAB morphs into
a 56dp close button pinned to the top-trailing corner of its footprint
(container primaryContainer → primary, icon onPrimaryContainer → onPrimary)
and the items reveal from the aligned edge, bottom item first — per
m3.material.io / Compose FloatingActionButtonMenu. Items use the
container/on-container roles of the chosen color set (primary / secondary /
tertiary). Closes on outside click, Escape, or item selection. Items may be
passed directly or inside Fragments.

Keyboard / focus (m3.material.io a11y + Compose FloatingActionButtonMenu +
WAI-ARIA APG menu): opening keeps focus on the toggle; Tab / ArrowDown from
the open toggle move to the top item (ArrowUp: the bottom one); ArrowUp /
ArrowDown cycle the items with wrap, Home / End jump, printable characters
move focus by typeahead; Shift+Tab returns to the toggle; Tab closes and
leaves the component; Escape and item selection close and return focus to
the toggle. While closed the item list is `inert`
and `aria-hidden`, so hidden items are out of the Tab order and the
accessibility tree while they still animate out.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description:
Accessible label for the toggle — describes the menu it opens. It stays
the same while open; the state is exposed through `aria-expanded`. Also
names the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: `FabMenuItem`s (up to six).

props.name: closeAriaLabel
color
props.description:
Color set. Items use its `*-container` roles; the open close button its
base roles (e.g. `primary` / `on-primary`).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: horizontalAlignment
props.description:
Horizontal alignment of the items above the FAB (Compose
`horizontalAlignment`): `end` (the default) aligns them to the FAB's
trailing edge for a FAB at the bottom-trailing corner, `start` to its
leading edge for a bottom-leading FAB, `center` centers them over it.
Items reveal from the same edge (from the middle for `center`). The close
button stays pinned to the top-trailing corner of the FAB's footprint
(Compose `ToggleFloatingActionButton` `contentAlignment = TopEnd`).
Logical — mirrored in RTL.

props.name: icon
props.description: FAB icon shown while the menu is closed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: size
props.description:
Size of the closed FAB — the menu can open from any FAB size (Fab
vocabulary). The close button is always 56dp, pinned to the top-trailing
corner of the FAB's footprint.

props.name: tonal
props.description:
Closed FAB colors: `true` (the default) uses the tonal `*-container`
roles, `false` the high-emphasis base roles (same as the open close
button) — the Fab `tonal` prop.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

IconButton.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Icon Button.

A native `<button>` (MUI-idiomatic `onClick`) supporting the 4 variants, the
Expressive size/width scale, and toggle mode. The state layer, ripple, and
focus ring come from shared primitives. The shape morphs to a tighter corner
while pressed (CSS `:active`) and round⇄square on toggle selection.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon (decorative; the button is labelled via aria-label).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selected state when toggled.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: selectedAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label swapped in when selected (toggle mode).

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Alternate icon shown while selected in toggle mode.

props.name: shape
props.description: Resting shape; morphs on press and on toggle selection.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: toggle
props.description: Enable toggle (selectable) behavior with aria-pressed.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis.

props.name: width
props.description: Container width footprint.

List.description:
MD3 (Expressive) list container — a vertical `<ul>` with 8dp block padding.

Items use the Expressive shapes (B18): 4dp corners at rest, 12dp while
hovered, 16dp while focused / pressed / selected, morphing with the
FastSpatial spring of the motion scheme (instant under reduced motion).
`variant="segmented"` separates the items into surface-colored segments.

Keyboard (m3 List accessibility): the focusable rows share **one Tab stop**
— the selected row, else the first (then the last focused one); **Down /
Right** move to the next row and **Up / Left** to the previous one,
wrapping at the ends (Left / Right mirrored in RTL), Home / End jump to
the ends. Controls in the rows' trailing slots — and in the leading slot
of a static row (e.g. a leading Checkbox) — stay Tab stops and are part of
the arrow sequence.

Selection (B17): set `selectionMode="single" | "multiple"` and give each
`ListItem` a `value`; the list owns the state via `value` / `defaultValue` /
`onChange(event, value)`. It then renders `role="listbox"` (label it with
`aria-label` describing the choice) and its items `role="option"` with
`aria-selected`; Enter / Space or a click selects. Options cannot hold
interactive controls (that is a multi-action list, not a selection list),
and selection should not rely on color alone — add a leading / trailing
check indicator.

props.name: defaultValue
props.type: string | number | readonly string[] | string[] | null
props.description:
Unused without a selection model (kept for HTMLAttributes compatibility).
Uncontrolled initial selected item value.
Uncontrolled initial selected item values.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ChangeEventHandler<HTMLUListElement, Element> | ((event: SyntheticEvent<Element, Event>, value: string | null) => void) | ((event: SyntheticEvent<...>, value: string[]) => void)
props.description:
Native `change` events bubbling from descendants.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected value.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected values.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected item value (`null` = none).
Controlled selected item values.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`standard`: items on a transparent container. `segmented`: each item is
its own surface-colored segment, 2dp apart, with 16dp outer corners on
the first and last item (Compose `SegmentedListItem`). Both use the
Expressive item shapes.

ListItem.description:
Material Design 3 list item.

Auto-sizes to one- (56dp), two- (72dp) or three-line (88dp) based on the
presence of `overline` / `supportingText`; supporting text that wraps also
makes the item three-line, and content 60dp or taller aligns top.
Colors follow ListTokens: headline OnSurface / BodyLarge, supporting &
overline OnSurfaceVariant, leading/trailing OnSurfaceVariant.

**Actionable rows** (`onClick` → `<button>`, `href` → `<a>`, B5): the
leading slot and the text form the primary action, which covers the whole
row (ripple, focus ring, click target); `trailing` is rendered as its
sibling, so trailing controls (Switch, icon button) are not nested inside
the button (MUI `ListItemButton` + `secondaryAction`). `role`, `tabIndex`,
`onKeyDown` and `aria-*` props go to the primary action.

Renders an `<li>`, except inside a `SwipeToDismiss` in a `List`, where the
SwipeToDismiss root is the `<li>` and the item renders a `<div>`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the item and dim its content to 38%.

props.name: headline
props.description: Primary text (headline).

props.name: href
props.description: Make the row a link: the primary action becomes an `<a href>`.

props.name: leading
props.description:
Leading element (icon, avatar, image, video; or a checkbox / radio /
switch on a static row). Not hidden from assistive technology — give
decorative icons `aria-hidden` and images an `alt`. On an actionable row
it is part of the primary action, so do not put controls here.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click handler. Providing it makes the row actionable: the leading slot
and the text become one `<button>` (the primary action).

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description:
Key handler of the focusable element — the primary action of an
actionable row, else the root. Runs before the row's own activation:
`event.preventDefault()` suppresses it.

props.name: overline
props.description: Small label above the headline.

props.name: rel
props.description: `<a rel>` — only with `href`.

props.name: selected
props.description:
Marks the item selected (secondary-container fill). Inside a `List` with
a `selectionMode`, the list's `value` decides instead.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Secondary text below the headline.

props.name: target
props.description: `<a target>` — only with `href`.

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Trailing element (icon, metadata, or controls such as a Switch / icon
button). On an actionable row it is rendered **beside** the primary
action, not inside it, so its controls stay separately focusable
(multi-action list). Non-interactive trailing content lets clicks
through to the row.

props.name: trailingSupportingText
props.description: Trailing metadata text (right-aligned label).

props.name: value
props.description:
The item's value in a `List` with a `selectionMode` (B17): the item then
renders `role="option"` with `aria-selected`.

LoadingIndicator.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Loading indicator.

A 48dp indicator whose 38dp active shape morphs through the seven Material
shapes (SoftBurst → Cookie9 → Pentagon → Pill → Sunny → Cookie4 → Oval) while
spinning. The shapes are traced from the official Material 3 Design Kit
vectors; the morph + per-step 90° kick run on a spring (dampingRatio 0.6) over
a linear global rotation, with cadence measured from the m3.material.io
reference. `contained` puts the OnPrimaryContainer shape on a PrimaryContainer
circle; `value` gives the determinate form (Circle → SoftBurst).

props.name: color
props.description: Active shape color (overrides the token default).

props.name: containerColor
props.description: Container fill for the `contained` variant (overrides PrimaryContainer).

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered diameter in px.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress `0..1` for the determinate indicator. Omit for indeterminate.

props.name: variant
props.description: `uncontained` (shape only) or `contained` (shape on a PrimaryContainer circle).

LocaleProvider.description:
Supplies the locale, hour cycle and built-in strings (Phase B B50) to every
component inside — so an app translates the library once instead of
passing `*Label` props to every instance.

Precedence: a component's own prop > the nearest provider > an outer
provider > the English default. Without a provider every component keeps
its English strings and `'en-US'`; the browser language is never read, so
server and client render the same output. Renders no element.

props.name: ampm
props.description:
12-hour clock with AM / PM (`true`) or 24-hour clock (`false`) — the
default `ampm` of every TimePicker inside. Without it the hour cycle of
the effective `locale` decides (m3: the 24-hour setting is made outside
the time picker, typically in system settings).

props.name: labels
props.description:
Built-in strings per component, e.g.
`{ Snackbar: { dismissLabel: '閉じる' }, Badge: { getLabel: … } }`. Keys
are the component's label props; a nested provider overrides single
keys of a component and inherits the rest.

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale — the default `locale` of DatePicker, DatePickerField and
TimePicker (month / weekday names, first day of the week, typed-date
order, the TimePicker's hour cycle). Inherited from an outer provider.

Menu.description:
Material Design 3 Menu (dropdown).

Anchors a `role="menu"` popup to a trigger. SurfaceContainer container, 4dp
corners, elevation 2, 112–280dp wide, 8dp vertical padding — per Compose
MenuTokens. Closes on outside press, Escape, Tab-out (or any focus move out
of it), or item selection. The trigger gets `aria-controls`, and the menu
is named by the trigger (`aria-labelledby`) unless it has its own label.
The menu is drawn in the top layer (Popover API) below the trigger — above
it when it doesn't fit below — and kept inside the viewport, so ancestors'
`overflow` / `z-index` can't clip it; it follows scrolling and layout shifts.

`variant="vertical"` renders the MD3 Expressive vertical menu (Compose
`DropdownMenuPopup`/`DropdownMenuGroup`): a transparent popup that stacks
`MenuGroup` containers (surface-container-low, elevation 2, 2dp gap) with
44dp items, 20dp icons, positional corner shapes, and a tertiary-based
selected state with a springy shape morph. `color="vibrant"` switches the
groups and items to the tertiary-container based high-emphasis mapping.

Selection (ruling B33): a `MenuGroup` with `selectionMode="single"` exposes
its items as `menuitemradio`, `"multiple"` as `menuitemcheckbox` and keeps
the menu open while toggling. Submenus and context menus (ruling B34): a
`MenuItem` with `submenu` opens a nested menu beside it; `anchorPosition`
opens the menu at a point (e.g. from `onContextMenu`).

Keyboard (WAI-ARIA APG menu-button pattern): Enter/Space/ArrowDown open and
focus the first item (ArrowUp: the last); ArrowUp/Down cycle with wrap;
Home/End jump; printable characters move focus by typeahead; Escape and
item activation close and return focus to the trigger. Items use a roving
tabindex (-1) so the closed/open menu never pollutes the page Tab order;
disabled items are focusable but inert (`aria-disabled`).

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment to the trigger.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Open at a point instead of below the trigger (MUI `anchorPosition`):
viewport coordinates, e.g. `{ top: event.clientY, left: event.clientX }`
from an `onContextMenu` handler. The menu opens below and after the point,
flipping above it and clamping inside the viewport when it doesn't fit.

props.name: children
props.description: `MenuItem`s — or, for the `vertical` variant, `MenuGroup`s.

props.name: color
props.description:
Color option for the `vertical` variant: `'standard'` (surface based) or
`'vibrant'` (tertiary based, higher emphasis).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state should change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The element that opens the menu (a single button-like element). Omit it
for a context menu positioned with `anchorPosition` (then control `open`
and give the menu an `aria-label`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`'standard'` is the baseline dropdown menu; `'vertical'` is the MD3
Expressive vertical menu (segmented `MenuGroup` containers, 44dp items,
selected states with shape morph).

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Whether activating the item closes the menu. Defaults to the group's
`closeOnSelect`, else `false` in a multi-select group (it stays open
until dismissed) and `true` otherwise.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon at the end of the item (decorative).

props.name: selected
props.description:
Selection state. When set (even to `false`) the item becomes a
`role="menuitemcheckbox"` (`menuitemradio` inside a single-select
`MenuGroup`) with `aria-checked`. A selected item shows the selected
container colors (vertical variant: tertiary container, morphing to a
12dp corner shape; baseline: secondary container). Inside a `MenuGroup`
with a `selectionMode`, leave it unset and give the item a `value`.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description:
Icon shown at the start while the item is selected (Compose
`selectedLeadingIcon` / `checkedLeadingIcon`), e.g. a check mark. It
replaces `startIcon`; without a `startIcon` it expands into view on
selection.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the item (decorative).

props.name: submenu
props.description:
Items of a submenu (`MenuItem`s / `MenuGroup`s) opened beside this item:
on hover (after a short delay), click, Enter / Space, or ArrowRight
(ArrowLeft in RTL); ArrowLeft (RTL: ArrowRight) or Escape returns to
this item. Pair it with an `endIcon` chevron, which mirrors in RTL.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Secondary text below the label (BodyMedium); it describes the item.

MenuGroup.description:
A group of items inside a `Menu` (`role="group"`, named by its `label`).

In a `variant="vertical"` menu it is a visually distinct container (Compose
`DropdownMenuGroup`): surface-container-low at elevation 2 whose corner
shape depends on its position in the menu (single group 16dp; first
16/8dp, middle 8dp, last 8/16dp), morphing to the 8dp inactive shape while
another group is hovered. In a baseline menu it only groups (and labels)
its items.

`selectionMode` (ruling B33) adds a selection model: give each `MenuItem` a
`value`; the group owns the state via `value` / `defaultValue` /
`onChange(event, value)`. `single` exposes `menuitemradio` items (selecting
one closes the menu), `multiple` exposes `menuitemcheckbox` items and keeps
the menu open until it is dismissed (m3 guidelines).

props.name: children
props.description: `MenuItem`s (and `MenuDivider`s).

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Default for the items' `closeOnSelect`: `false` keeps the menu open while
the items are activated.

props.name: defaultValue
props.type: string | number | readonly string[] | string[] | null
props.description:
Unused without a selection model (kept for HTMLAttributes compatibility).
Uncontrolled initial selected item value.
Uncontrolled initial selected item values.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional section label rendered above the group's items.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ChangeEventHandler<HTMLDivElement, Element> | ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>, value: string | null) => void) | ((event: MouseEvent<...>, value: string[]) => void)
props.description:
Native `change` events bubbling from descendants.
Fires with the activating event and the selected value.
Fires with the activating event and the next selected values.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected item value (`null` = none).
Controlled selected item values.

NavigationBar.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) flexible Navigation bar (bottom).

A 64dp-minimum SurfaceContainer bar of destinations (Compose
`ShortNavigationBar`; the 80dp baseline bar is no longer recommended by
m3.material.io). The active item shows a 56×32 SecondaryContainer pill
behind its 24dp icon (OnSecondaryContainer) and a Secondary LabelMedium
label; inactive items are OnSurfaceVariant. The bar grows vertically when
labels wrap at larger text sizes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial destination value.

props.name: itemLayout
props.description:
Item layout: icon over label (`vertical`) or beside it (`horizontal`).
Horizontal items are centered with the extra width at both ends of the bar
(20 / 15 / 10 / 5 % per side for 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 items).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected destination value.

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge on the icon: content (e.g. `"3"`) for a large badge, `true` for a small dot.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
Accessible text for the badge, announced after the label. Defaults to
`"{badge} new notifications"` for a counting badge and `"New notification"`
for a dot.

props.name: icon
props.description: The item icon (outlined, per m3.material.io, when `selectedIcon` is given).

props.name: label
props.description:
The item label. Without a label, give the item an `aria-label` (which then
also replaces the announced badge text).

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description:
Icon shown while this destination is selected — typically the filled
version of `icon` (m3: filled for the selected destination, outlined for
the rest). Falls back to `icon`.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the destination; matched against the parent value.

NavigationDrawer.description:
Material Design 3 Navigation drawer (standard or modal).

360dp SurfaceContainerLow (modal) / Surface (standard) panel, rounded 16dp on
the trailing edge. Items are 56dp full pills (CornerFull): active =
SecondaryContainer / OnSecondaryContainer, inactive transparent /
OnSurfaceVariant, LabelLarge — per Compose NavigationDrawerTokens. Modal adds
a 0.32 Scrim, Escape-to-close, and `role="dialog" aria-modal`.

`dismissible` (Compose `DismissibleNavigationDrawer`) is the standard
Surface panel toggled by `open`: it opens on DefaultSpatial and closes on
FastEffects by sliding its inline-start margin, so place it as the first
child of a flex (or grid) row next to the content — the content is pushed
aside rather than covered (give the row `overflow: hidden` so the sliding
panel stays clipped). There is no scrim or focus trap. Opening moves focus
to the selected (else first) item, as Compose does; Escape inside the
drawer calls `onClose`; a closed drawer is `inert`, and closing it with
focus inside returns focus to where it was before opening. Pair it with a
menu button carrying `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`.

A modal drawer mounted with `open` slides in like one opened later. Initial
focus (modal): an element React's `autoFocus` focused inside it, else the
element marked `data-autofocus`, else the first tabbable element.
`autoFocus` only runs when its element mounts, so for content rendered
while the drawer is closed mark the target with `data-autofocus` instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial destination value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called with the triggering event and the `reason` when the drawer asks to
close: Escape (`modal`, and `dismissible` while focus is inside it) or a
scrim click (`modal`).

props.name: open
props.description: Open state of a `modal` / `dismissible` drawer (controlled).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected destination value (shared with items).

props.name: variant

NavigationRailItem.description:
A destination inside a `NavigationRail`.

The whole row is the (full-width) click target; the active indicator is a
pill that hugs its content — a 56×32 pill around the icon when collapsed,
growing to wrap icon + label when expanded. Layout is a single stable DOM
whose pill, icon and label are absolutely positioned and interpolated from
the inherited `--_t` morph value (0 = collapsed, 1 = expanded), so the tween
driving `--_t` produces a continuous morph with no reflow. The label's
natural width is measured into `--_label-w` so the pill can hug it.

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge on the icon: content (e.g. `"3"`) for a large badge, `true` for a small dot.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
Accessible text for the badge, announced after the label. Defaults to
`"{badge} new notifications"` for a counting badge and `"New notification"`
for a dot.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Layout when used standalone (outside a `NavigationRail`): `false` =
collapsed (icon over label), `true` = expanded (icon beside label in a
pill). Toggling runs the same spring morph the rail uses. Inside a
`NavigationRail` this is ignored — the rail's `variant` governs.

props.name: icon
props.description: The item icon (outlined, per m3.material.io, when `selectedIcon` is given).

props.name: label
props.description:
The item label. Without a label, give the item an `aria-label` (which then
also replaces the announced badge text).

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state when used standalone (outside a `NavigationRail`).

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description:
Icon shown while this destination is selected — typically the filled
version of `icon` (m3: filled for the selected destination, outlined for
the rest). Falls back to `icon`.

props.name: value
props.description: Destination value; selected state is derived from the parent rail.

NavigationRail.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Navigation rail — the Compose
`WideNavigationRail` with `collapsed` / `expanded` variants that morph on a
spring. Collapsed is a 96dp Surface column of icon-over-label destinations
with a 56×32 SecondaryContainer pill on the active item; expanded grows to
fit its widest destination (min 220dp, max 360dp — Compose
`WideNavigationRail`) and lays each destination out as icon + label in a
pill, with badges beside the label.
The whole transition (width, item spacing, and every item's icon/label/pill)
is interpolated from a single spring value. An optional `header` (menu button,
FAB) is pinned at the top.

props.name: arrangement
props.description: Vertical placement of the destinations below the header.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial destination value.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional header content (e.g. a menu button and/or FAB) pinned at the top.

props.name: hideOnCollapse
props.description:
With `modal`: hide the rail entirely while collapsed; expanding slides the
expanded rail in from the leading edge. Ignored without `modal`.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Modal expanded layout: while `variant="expanded"` the rail overlaps the
page instead of pushing it — surface-container, 16dp trailing corners,
level-2 shadow, a 0.32 scrim, focus trapped inside, the rest of the page
inert, Escape / scrim click call `onClose`, and focus returns to the
opener on collapse. Collapsed, it is a regular in-flow 96dp rail (or
nothing, with `hideOnCollapse`). Mounted expanded, it plays the same
expand motion as expanding later. Initial focus: an element React's
`autoFocus` focused inside the rail, else the element marked
`data-autofocus`, else the first tabbable element — `autoFocus` only runs
when its element mounts, so for content rendered while collapsed use
`data-autofocus`.

props.name: modalLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open modal rail (a dialog).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
With `modal`: called when the scrim is clicked or Escape is pressed, with
the triggering event and the `reason`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected destination value.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`collapsed` (96dp, icon-over-label) or `expanded` (icon beside label in a
pill; the rail is as wide as its widest item, 220–360dp). The change is a
spring morph.

props.name: shape
props.description: Indicator shape.

props.name: size
props.defaultValue:
40 (flat) / 48 (wavy) for a 4dp thickness; each extra dp of
thickness adds 1 (flat 8dp = 44, wavy 8dp = 52)
props.description:
Outer diameter of the indicator in pixels. The stroke thickness, the 4dp
track gap and the wave keep their dp size whatever the diameter.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Indicator thickness in dp.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress value from 0 to 1. Omit for indeterminate progress.

props.name: shape
props.description: Indicator shape.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Indicator thickness in dp.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress value from 0 to 1. Omit for indeterminate progress.

PullToRefresh.description:
Material Design 3 pull-to-refresh (Compose `PullToRefreshBox`).

The component **is the scroll container**: give it a height (or a flex /
grid track) and put the content inside. A downward pull that starts while
the container — and every scrollable element between it and the pointer —
is scrolled to the top drags the indicator in at half the finger speed (with
Compose's tension past the threshold); releasing beyond `threshold` (80px)
calls `onRefresh`. While pulling the indicator is determinate (its progress
is the pulled fraction); while `refreshing` it sits at the threshold and is
indeterminate. Touch (non-passive touch listeners) and mouse / pen (pointer
events) both pull. Under reduced motion the indicator does not travel: it
fades in at its resting position.

The gesture is not keyboard-reachable — always provide a visible refresh
control too. The root carries `aria-busy` while refreshing and a polite
live region announces `refreshingLabel`.

Styling hooks on the root: `data-indicator`, `data-refreshing`,
`data-pulling`, `data-disabled`, and `--md-pull-to-refresh-progress`
(the indicator's distance fraction, 0 at rest, 1 at the threshold, up to 2).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the pull gesture (an ongoing refresh is still shown).

props.name: indicator
props.description: Indicator flavor.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description:
Fires when a pull is released past `threshold`. Return a promise to keep
the indicator spinning until it settles when `refreshing` is not
controlled.

props.name: refreshing
props.description:
Controlled refreshing state (Compose `isRefreshing`): the indicator sits
at the threshold and spins while `true`. Omit it to let the component
track the promise returned by `onRefresh` instead.

props.name: refreshingLabel
props.description: Text announced by the polite live region when refreshing starts.

props.name: threshold
props.description:
Distance (px, after the 0.5 drag resistance) a pull must exceed to
refresh on release (Compose `PositionalThreshold` 80dp).

Radio.description:
Material Design 3 Radio Button.

Uses a native `<input type="radio">` for proper form integration and
accessibility. The visual outer ring, inner dot, and state layer are rendered
via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
Uncontrolled initial checked state (native input behavior — the browser
manages group exclusivity for radios sharing a `name`).

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the native event and this radio's `value` (as a string — the
same value a wrapping `RadioGroup` reports) when the radio is selected.

RadioGroup.description:
Groups `Radio` components: distributes a shared `name`, manages the selected
value (controlled via `value` or uncontrolled via `defaultValue`), and
exposes a `role="radiogroup"` landmark. Label the group with `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`. Arrow-key navigation between radios comes from the native
inputs sharing the group name.

props.name: children
props.description: `Radio` elements (any depth).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every radio in the group.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared input name for the group. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the newly selected value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value.

ScrollField.description:
Material Design 3 Expressive scroll field (Compose `ScrollField`): a
vertical, endlessly wrapping wheel of numbers that snaps the selected value
to its centre. 200px tall by default (Compose `ScrollFieldHeight`), Large
corners, SurfaceContainerLowest; the centred value is DisplayLarge
Emphasized in OnSurface, the others DisplayMedium in Outline.

It is an ARIA `spinbutton` (`aria-valuenow` / `aria-valuetext` / min / max):
ArrowUp / ArrowDown step by one (wrapping), PageUp / PageDown by
`pageStep`, Home / End jump to `min` / `max`. The mouse wheel moves one
value per notch; drag (touch, mouse, pen) scrolls and snaps, with a short
fling; tapping a neighbouring value scrolls to it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled: dimmed colors, no interaction, out of the Tab order.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Text drawn for a value.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: `aria-valuetext` for a value — include the unit (e.g. `"7 o'clock"`).

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value (inclusive). The wheel wraps from `max` back to `min`.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the new value as the wheel moves (keyboard, wheel, drag,
tap). The event is the native event behind the change.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: Values moved by PageUp / PageDown.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (an integer from `min` to `max`).

SearchBar.description:
Material Design 3 Search bar (docked field + search view).

56dp SurfaceContainerHigh stadium field (360–720dp wide); OnSurface
BodyLarge input with a Primary caret, OnSurfaceVariant placeholder, 48dp
leading / trailing slots — per Compose SearchBarTokens and m3.material.io.
Hover / pressed state layer and a keyboard-only focus ring on the bar.
Providing `children` (results) turns it into a docked search view in the
Expressive "contained" style: a 12dp results container 2dp under the bar
over a scrim, opening on focus and closing on Escape / outside click /
scrim click. The view is drawn in the top layer (Popover API), pinned under
the bar at the bar's width, so ancestors' `overflow` / `z-index` can't clip
it; like Compose's docked view it never flips above the bar.

With a view, the input is an APG-style `role="combobox"` (`aria-expanded`,
`aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`) and the view's opening is
announced via `suggestionsLabel`. Keyboard: ArrowDown opens the view /
moves into the results, ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End move between the
focusable result items (ArrowUp from the first returns to the input),
Escape closes the view from anywhere in it and returns focus to the input
(typing, or pressing the focused input, reopens it), and moving focus out of the component closes it. While the view is open,
Escape only closes it (the native `type="search"` clear is suppressed);
with the view closed — or without a view — Escape keeps the browser's
native behavior (Chromium / Safari clear the query). Enter calls
`onSearch`, except while an IME composition is in progress.
A consumer `onKeyDown` that calls `preventDefault()` opts out of the
built-in key handling for that event.

`layout="fullscreen"` (Compose `ExpandedFullScreenContainedSearchBar`, the
Expressive contained style) instead opens a modal view over the whole
viewport (`role="dialog"`, drawn in the top layer): a SurfaceContainerLow
surface fades in while the field moves from the bar to the top (4dp from
the top, 8dp from the sides) with a back button in place of the leading
icon, and the results fill the space 8dp below it — no divider. Expand and
collapse run on the FastSpatial spring (reduced motion: a fade). Focus is
trapped in the view (`useModal`); Escape or the back button collapses it
and focus returns to the bar. The bar opens it on a click, typing or
ArrowDown — focus alone (Tab) doesn't (a modal shouldn't open on Tab).
`onChange` / `onSearch` / `onKeyDown` follow the view's field;
`onFocus` / `onBlur` / `inputRef` stay on the bar's input.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and any extra props (`{...rest}`) land on
the ROOT element (the `role="search"` landmark); input concerns are
dedicated props (`placeholder`, `name`, `onFocus`, `onKeyDown`, …),
`inputRef` reaches the native `<input>`, and `inputProps` spreads extra
attributes on it (the component's own wiring wins).

props.name: backLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the full-screen view's back button. Localize it
with the rest of your UI strings.

props.name: children
props.description: Suggestion / result content shown in the open search view.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and applies disabled styling.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Trailing icon / control (48dp slot, e.g. a mic or clear `IconButton`).

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the native `<input>` — the escape hatch for
attributes without a dedicated prop (e.g. a distinct `aria-label` for
the searchbox, `maxLength`, `pattern`, extra `aria-*`, …).
Precedence: the component's own wiring always wins over conflicting
`inputProps` keys — the controlled `value` / `onChange` and internal
`onFocus` / `onKeyDown` handling, `type="search"`, `className`, and
every dedicated input prop the component sets (`placeholder`, `name`,
`disabled`, …).

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: layout
props.description:
How the search view (`children`) opens:
- `'docked'` — a results container pinned 2dp under the bar, over a
  scrim (Compose `ExpandedDockedSearchBarWithGap`; larger screens).
- `'fullscreen'` — a modal view covering the viewport: the field moves
  to the top with a back button in place of the leading icon and the
  results below it (Compose `ExpandedFullScreenContainedSearchBar`, the
  Expressive contained style; compact screens). Focus is trapped inside
  it; Escape or the back button closes it and focus returns to the bar.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input `name`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Blur handler for the native input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the new query.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus handler for the native input.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key handler for the native input.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state should change.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Fires when the user submits (Enter).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open (search-view) state.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native input `placeholder`.

props.name: startIcon
props.description:
Leading content (defaults to a decorative search glyph). Rendered in a
48dp slot, so it may be a navigation `IconButton` (back / menu) — it
stays in the tab order and the accessibility tree. A purely decorative
custom icon should carry `aria-hidden` itself. Pass `false` for no
leading icon at all (the text then starts 24dp in — e.g. in a search
app bar whose navigation icon sits outside the field).

props.name: suggestionsLabel
props.description:
Text announced (polite live region) when the search view opens — the
equivalent of Compose's "Suggestions below" state description.
Localize it with the rest of your UI strings.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled query value.

SegmentedButton.description:
Material Design 3 Segmented Buttons (single- or multi-select).

A 40dp stadium row of equal-width outlined segments (Outline 1dp). Selected
segments fill with SecondaryContainer / OnSecondaryContainer and show an
18dp check in an always-reserved icon slot, so selecting never resizes the
row; unselected are transparent with OnSurface content — per Compose
OutlinedSegmentedButtonTokens / SegmentedButtonContent.

Single-select is a `radiogroup` (one Tab stop; arrow keys move focus and
select, as in the WAI-ARIA APG radio group and `ButtonGroup`; Space / Enter
select); multi-select is a `group` of `aria-pressed` toggle buttons (each a
Tab stop; arrow keys move focus only). Name the group with `aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby`.

In Material 3 Expressive the segmented button is no longer recommended:
m3.material.io says connected button groups replace it. Prefer
`<ButtonGroup variant="connected" selectionMode="single" | "multiple">` with
`Button` / `IconButton` children that carry a `value`. SegmentedButton stays
available (Compose still ships it) and is not deprecated.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selection.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the whole group.

props.name: multiSelect
props.description:
Allow selecting multiple segments. Single-select renders a `radiogroup`
of radios; multi-select renders a `group` of toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`).
Allow selecting multiple segments.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>, value: string) => void) | ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>, value: string[]) => void)
props.description:
Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected value — on click,
Space / Enter (the native button `click`) and arrow-key selection. Not
fired when the selected segment is activated again.
Fires with the triggering event and the next selected values. Keyboard
activation (Space / Enter) arrives as the native button `click`.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description: Show a check icon on selected segments.
