Select.description:
Material Design 3 Select — the non-editable exposed dropdown menu
(Compose `ExposedDropdownMenuBox` + a read-only `TextField` with the
`PrimaryNotEditable` anchor, `ExposedDropdownMenu(matchAnchorWidth = true)`).

The field is the `TextField` anatomy (filled / outlined, floating label,
start icon, supporting / error text) with the `ArrowDropDown` trailing icon,
rotated 180° while open. The listbox is drawn in the top layer below the
field (flipped above when there is no room, clamped to the viewport),
exactly as wide as the field and capped to the room left on that side —
styled after the Compose sample: a surface-container-low, 16dp-corner,
elevation-2 surface with 44dp body-large options (16dp padding, positional
corners), and a tertiary-container selected option with a check mark that
morphs to 12dp corners.

Accessibility follows the WAI-ARIA APG select-only combobox: the field is a
focusable `role="combobox"` that keeps focus while the `role="listbox"`
popup is open, the active option is exposed through
`aria-activedescendant`. Closed: ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Enter / Space /
Alt+ArrowDown open (Home / End open on the first / last option), and
typing opens on the matching option. Open: ArrowUp / ArrowDown move (no
wrap), Home / End / PageUp / PageDown jump, typing moves by typeahead,
Enter / Space / Alt+ArrowUp select and close, Tab selects and moves on,
Escape closes without selecting. Disabled options are skipped.

A visually hidden native `<input>` carries `name` / `value` for form
submission, `required` validation, and form reset (uncontrolled values
return to `defaultValue`).

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the combobox on mount.

props.name: children
props.description: `Option` elements (direct children or inside Fragments).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field (and leaves the value out of form submission).

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — error colors, `aria-invalid`, and `errorText`. Ignored while `disabled`.

props.name: errorText
props.description:
Shown instead of `supportingText` (with `role="alert"`) when `error` is set.
Accepts rich content, like `supportingText`.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the hidden native input with a `<form>` elsewhere in the page (native `form` attribute).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the field (and therefore the listbox) to the container's width.

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the `role="combobox"` element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the hidden native `<input>` that carries the value for forms (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: label
props.description:
Floating label; also names the combobox and the listbox. Rendered with a trailing `*` when `required`.

Accepts rich content (text, emphasis, a small icon) — keep it short and
on one line, as m3 asks: the label is a single line (truncated with an
ellipsis), clicks on it go to the field, and the outlined notch draws a
hidden copy of it to measure its width. So no links or buttons in the
label, and no elements with an `id`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of the hidden native input that carries the value.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires when the user picks a different option — with the click or key
event and the new value (A2). Not fired on form reset.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the listbox should open or close.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the listbox.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the field while nothing is selected (once the label has floated, or always without a label).

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a value for form submission (native constraint validation) and appends `*` to the label.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the field (decorative).

props.name: supportingText
props.description:
Helper line below the field. Replaced by `errorText` while in error.
Accepts rich content — a short link is fine (it stays reachable and is
part of the field's description via `aria-describedby`); keep it to
about one line, as m3 asks.

props.name: tonal
props.description:
Expressive tonal style, as TextField `tonal` (Compose `tonalColors()` +
`roundedShape`): 12dp rounded container, no indicator on `filled`,
outline-variant border and inside label on `outlined`.
@experimental Compose still marks these values `TODO(b/448727879)`, so
the look may change when the spec settles.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value (`''` = nothing selected).

props.name: variant
props.description: Text field container style (the same two as `TextField`).

SideSheet.description:
Material Design 3 Side sheet (standard or modal).

A 400dp max-width panel anchored to the right (or left) edge. Standard
= inline Surface panel; modal = SurfaceContainerLow over a 0.32 Scrim with
`role="dialog" aria-modal` and Escape-to-close — per m3.material.io specs.
Header uses 24dp side padding (16dp with a back icon), 12dp gaps, a Title
Large headline, and optional back/close IconButtons. Bottom actions are a
72dp left-aligned bar.

A modal sheet mounted with `open` slides in like one opened later. Initial
focus (modal): an element React's `autoFocus` focused inside it, else the
element marked `data-autofocus`, else the first tabbable element.
`autoFocus` only runs when its element mounts, so for content rendered
while the sheet is closed mark the target with `data-autofocus` instead.

props.name: actions
props.description: Bottom action bar content (left-aligned buttons).

props.name: anchor
props.description: Physical edge the sheet is anchored to; it does not flip in RTL.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the back button.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button.

props.name: headline
props.description: Title shown in the header.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Called when the back button is clicked.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called on close-button click, scrim click, or Escape, with the
triggering event and the `reason`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is shown.

props.name: showBackButton
props.description: Show a leading back button (modal).

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Show the trailing close button.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show a divider between the header and content.

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard (inline) or modal (overlay + scrim).

Slider.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Slider.

Native `<input type="range">`(s) overlaid on MD3 visuals: five sizes (XS–XL,
track 16–96dp / handle 44–108dp), single or **range** (`[start, end]`),
**centered** (active from the midpoint), **vertical** orientation, optional
tick marks, value-indicator bubble, and an **inset icon** in the handle
(md/lg/xl). Handle Primary, active track Primary, inactive SecondaryContainer;
disabled active 38% / inactive 12% — per m3.material.io & Compose SliderTokens.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and `{...rest}` land on the ROOT element;
`inputRef` reaches the first native `<input type="range">`.

props.name: centered
props.description: Draw the active track from the center outward.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: inputRef
props.description:
Ref to the native `<input type="range">` element (the forwarded `ref`
points at the root). A range slider renders two inputs; `inputRef`
reaches the FIRST (start / minimum) one — query its siblings for the end
input if needed.

props.name: insetIcon
props.description: Icon shown inside the handle (sizes md/lg/xl only).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the new value (same shape as `value`).

props.name: onChangeCommitted
props.type: ((event: Event | SyntheticEvent<Element, Event>, value: SliderValue) => void)
props.description:
Fires when an interaction ends (Compose `onValueChangeFinished`, ruling
B47): on pointer release (end of a drag, or a tap), on the keyup of each
value key (arrows, Home / End, PageUp / PageDown), and right after a
direct value change from assistive technology (only when the value
changed). `value` is the last value reported to `onChange`. `onChange`
keeps firing continuously during a drag.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation.

props.name: rangeEndLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the end (maximum) thumb of a range slider.

props.name: rangeStartLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the start (minimum) thumb of a range slider.

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Render tick marks at each step.

props.name: showValueLabel
props.description: Show the value-indicator bubble on hover / focus / drag.

props.name: size
props.description: Expressive size (track thickness / handle height).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (`number`, or `[start, end]` for range).

props.name: valueLabelFormat
props.description:
Format the value-indicator label. A `string` / `number` result is also
announced via `aria-valuetext` so AT reads what the label shows.

Snackbar.description:
Material Design 3 Snackbar (the visual bar).

The presentational surface. For queueing, auto-dismiss timing, placement and
enter/exit motion, render snackbars through `SnackbarProvider` /
`useSnackbar()` instead of placing this component yourself.

Standalone, it is a polite live region (`role="status"`); override `role` /
`aria-live` when a surrounding host already provides the live region. It
fills the available width up to 600dp (Compose `ContainerMaxWidth`).

Colors follow SnackbarTokens: InverseSurface container, InverseOnSurface
message (BodyMedium), InversePrimary action (LabelLarge), InverseOnSurface
dismiss icon, corner 4dp, elevation level 3. The action is a text button
(40dp tall, 58dp min width, 12dp padding) and the dismiss is a standard icon
button (24dp icon in a 48dp area flush with the trailing edge), both with the
shared state layers, ripple and focus ring.

props.name: action
props.description:
Optional single action — an `{ label, onClick }` text button (rendered as
an inverse-primary `Button variant="text"`) or a custom node (m3: never a
filled or elevated button).

props.name: actionOnNewLine
props.description:
Places the action on its own line below the message, end-aligned — for a
long action label (m3 "two lines with longer action"; Compose
`actionOnNewLine`). Opt-in only; the layout is never chosen automatically.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the dismiss icon button.

props.name: message
props.description:
The message text (supporting text). Keep it short and plain — m3 advises
against stylized text, inline links and icons in snackbars.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
When provided, shows a trailing dismiss (close) icon button, and pressing
Escape while focus is inside the snackbar also dismisses it. Receives the
triggering event and the reason.

SnackbarProvider.description:
Hosts snackbars for its subtree (Compose `SnackbarHost` +
`SnackbarHostState`). Descendants call `useSnackbar().show()`.

- Shows one snackbar at a time; later calls queue behind it.
- Auto-dismiss: short 4s / long 10s / indefinite; indefinite by default when
  there is an action. The timer pauses on hover and while focus is inside.
- Placement: bottom-center with 12dp margins, filling the width up to 600dp.
  The host is `position: fixed` and rendered inside this provider (so it
  inherits the theme's color tokens). While a snackbar shows, the host is
  drawn in the browser top layer and kept above open modals (Dialog,
  sheets…), which are top-layer too (ruling B45); without Popover API
  support it falls back to `z-index` — keep the provider outside
  transformed ancestors there.
- A persistent polite live region (`role="status"`) is mounted with the
  provider, and only its content changes, so screen readers announce each
  message.
- Escape dismisses while focus is inside; when a focused snackbar closes,
  focus returns to the element focused before it.
- Enter / exit: fade + scale 0.8↔1; fade only under reduced motion.

Web guidance (m3 a11y): information in an auto-dismissing snackbar must also
be available elsewhere in the UI, and apps should offer a documented
shortcut (e.g. Alt+G) to move focus to a snackbar with an action.

props.name: className
props.description: Class for the host (the fixed, bottom-centered placement container).

props.name: style
props.description:
Style for the host — e.g. raise it above a bottom navigation bar with
`{ bottom: 80 }`.

SplitButton.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Split button.

A leading action button joined to a trailing menu button (2dp gap). Both
halves are styled by `Button` itself (same colors, disabled state, outline,
typography and 48dp touch target); the outer corners are round (CornerFull)
and the inner corners small, growing on hover / focus / press. Opening the
menu morphs the trailing button's inner corner to round, tints it with the
selected state layer and rotates its chevron 180° — the signature
split-button interaction (per m3.material.io split-button specs). Reuses
`Menu` for the dropdown and the shared Ripple / FocusRing primitives.

An icon-only leading button (`startIcon` without `children`) needs an
`aria-label`, which is forwarded to the leading button.

props.name: children
props.description: Leading action button label.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: menu
props.description: `MenuItem`s shown when the trailing button opens the menu.

props.name: menuAlign
props.description: Menu alignment to the trailing button.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the menu open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled menu open state.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

props.name: trailingAriaLabel
props.description:
Accessible label for the trailing menu button. Prefer a label tied to the
leading action (e.g. "More send options").

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis (shared by both buttons).

SwipeToDismiss.description:
Material Design 3 Swipe-to-dismiss row (Compose `SwipeToDismissBox`).

A horizontally draggable row over a caller-provided background. Dragging
starts after an 8px touch slop (so nested buttons and clickable rows keep
their clicks); on release the row dismisses on a fling ≥125px/s or past the
56px `threshold` in the direction of motion, and otherwise snaps to the
nearest anchor. Directions are logical (mirrored in RTL). `onDismiss` fires
after the exit animation; `dismissed` (controlled / uncontrolled) resets or
dismisses programmatically — provide a non-gesture alternative (e.g. a
delete button) that sets it. Gestures are disabled while dismissed.

Inside a `List`, the root renders the `<li>` and the nested `ListItem`
renders a `<div>`, keeping list semantics.

Styling hooks on the root: `data-direction` (current swipe / dismiss
direction), `data-target` (anchor the row would settle at if released now:
`settled` / `startToEnd` / `endToStart`), `data-dismissed`, `data-dragging`,
and `--md-swipe-to-dismiss-progress` (0–1, swiped distance / row width).

props.name: background
props.description: Content revealed behind the row, for either direction (fallback).

props.name: defaultDismissed
props.description: Initial dismissed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: dismissed
props.description:
Controlled dismissed state: `null` = settled (row in place), a direction =
dismissed that way. Changing it animates the row — set a direction to
dismiss programmatically (e.g. from a delete button, the non-gesture
alternative m3 requires), set `null` to reset / cancel a dismissal.

props.name: enableEndToStart
props.description: Allow end→start dismissal.

props.name: enableStartToEnd
props.description: Allow start→end (reading-direction) dismissal.

props.name: endToStartBackground
props.description: Content revealed while swiping end→start (overrides `background`).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
Fires once the row has finished sliding out and settled in the dismissed
position (immediately under reduced motion) — the place to remove the
item. Also fires after a programmatic dismiss (`dismissed`).

props.name: onDismissedChange
props.description:
Fires when a swipe is released into a dismiss anchor (at release, before
the exit animation). In controlled mode, keep the value `null` to veto.

props.name: startToEndBackground
props.description: Content revealed while swiping start→end (overrides `background`).

props.name: threshold
props.description:
Positional threshold (px) a slow release must pass, in the direction of
motion, to dismiss (Compose `positionalThreshold` 56dp).

Switch.description:
Material Design 3 Switch.

Uses a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` for proper form
integration and accessibility. The visual track, handle, and icons are
rendered via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state.

props.name: icons
props.description: Show icons on both states.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the next selected state on toggle.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected (on) state.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Icon shown when selected.

props.name: unselectedIcon
props.description: Icon shown when unselected.

TabContext.description:
Links a `Tabs` row to its `TabPanel`s (WAI-ARIA APG Tabs): holds the
selection (controlled / uncontrolled) and gives every tab an `id` and an
`aria-controls` pointing at the `TabPanel` with the same `value`, which is
in turn `aria-labelledby` its tab. Renders no element. Put `value` /
`defaultValue` / `onChange` here; the inner `Tabs`' own `onChange` still
fires.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial tab value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected tab value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab value, shared by the `Tabs` and `TabPanel`s inside.

Tabs.description:
Material Design 3 Tabs (a `role="tablist"` row of `Tab`s).

Fixed tabs split the row into equal widths; scrollable tabs size to their
content (90dp minimum) with 52dp edge padding and scroll the selected tab to
the center whenever the selection changes. A single active indicator slides
between tabs: primary = content-width (min 24dp) 3dp bar with 3dp top
corners, secondary = full-tab-width 2dp line. Both sit above an
OutlineVariant 1dp divider. Arrow keys move focus between tabs; Space /
Enter select (manual activation, m3 a11y). Tabs with `href` are navigation
links. Inside a `TabContext`, tabs are linked to their `TabPanel`s. The
container color is the `--md-tabs-container-color` custom property
(default `--md-sys-color-surface`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial tab value.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected tab value. Not
fired when the selected tab is activated again, or when the tab's own
`onClick` called `event.preventDefault()`. On a link (`href`) tab it
fires before the browser follows the link; call `event.preventDefault()`
here to navigate with a client-side router instead.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Scrollable tabs size to content and scroll horizontally instead of filling.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Indicator style.

Tab.description: A single tab; must be rendered inside `Tabs`. With `href` it is a link tab.

props.name: badge
props.description:
A `<Badge>` (without children). It is placed on the icon, or next to the
label when the tab has no icon, and takes no layout space (the active
indicator still follows the label / icon). Its accessible text (the
Badge `label`, or the default "New notification" / "{n} new
notifications") is read after the tab label.

props.name: download
props.description: `<a download>` — only with `href`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Make the tab a navigation link (m3 navigation tab): renders
`<a role="tab" href>` with the same look, keyboard behavior (arrows move
focus, Space / Enter activate) and selection through the `Tabs` value.
The browser follows the link; `onChange` fires first (not for
Ctrl / Cmd / Shift / Alt clicks, which open elsewhere), so a client-side
router can `preventDefault()` there and navigate itself. Link tabs have
no `TabPanel` (no `aria-controls`) and no `aria-current` (the selection
is `aria-selected`; pass `aria-current` yourself if needed).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon (24dp), above the label or before it (see `iconPosition`).

props.name: iconPosition
props.description:
Icon placement: `'top'` stacks the icon above the label (64dp tab),
`'start'` puts it before the label with an 8dp gap (48dp tab, Compose
`LeadingIconTab`). Available on both variants, but m3 secondary tabs
normally have no icon (the secondary anatomy has none).

props.name: label
props.description: Tab label.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click handler (button or link tab). `event.preventDefault()` keeps the
selection (and, on a link tab, the navigation) from happening.

props.name: rel
props.description: `<a rel>` — only with `href`.

props.name: target
props.description: `<a target>` — only with `href`.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the tab; matched against the parent `Tabs` value.

TabPanel.description:
The content of one tab (`role="tabpanel"`); must be rendered inside a
`TabContext`. Hidden (`hidden`, still mounted) unless its `value` is
selected. `tabIndex` defaults to `0` so the panel itself is reachable with
Tab (APG, for panels that do not start with focusable content); pass
`tabIndex={-1}` when the panel starts with a focusable element.

props.name: value
props.description: The `Tab` value this panel belongs to.

TextField.description:
Material Design 3 Text field (filled / outlined, optionally `tonal`).

A single-line `<input>` — or auto-growing `<textarea>` with `multiline` —
wrapped in the MD3 field anatomy: floating label (outlined variant notches
the border; `shrinkLabel` keeps it minimized, `labelPlacement="above"`
moves it above the container), start/end icons, prefix/suffix text, and a supporting
line that holds helper text, the error message, and the `maxLength`
counter. Value follows the standard controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or
uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) input pattern; clicking anywhere on the
container focuses the input.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and any extra props (`{...rest}`) land on
the ROOT element; input concerns are dedicated props (`type`, `name`,
`placeholder`, `required`, `readOnly`, `autoComplete`, `maxLength`, …),
`inputRef` reaches the native `<input>` / `<textarea>`, and `inputProps`
spreads extra attributes on it (the component's own wiring wins).

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Native input `autoComplete`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and applies disabled styling.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon at the end of the field (decorative).

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — error colors, `aria-invalid`, and `errorText`. Ignored while `disabled`.

props.name: errorText
props.description:
Shown instead of `supportingText` (with `role="alert"`) when `error` is set.
Accepts rich content, like `supportingText`.

props.name: getCounterLabel
props.description:
Accessible wording for the `maxLength` counter (the visible `3 / 20` is
hidden from assistive tech in favor of this text).

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the native input (keeps the floating label association via `htmlFor`).

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the native `<input>` (or `<textarea>` when
`multiline`) — the escape hatch for attributes without a dedicated prop
(`pattern`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `onKeyDown`, extra `aria-*`, …).
Precedence: the component's own wiring always wins over conflicting
`inputProps` keys — the controlled `value` / `onChange` / `onFocus` /
`onBlur`, `id`, `className`, and every dedicated input prop that is
given (`type`, `name`, `placeholder`, `required`, `readOnly`,
`disabled`, `autoComplete`, `maxLength`, `rows`, …). A dedicated prop
that is omitted never overrides `inputProps`, even when it has a
default: `inputProps={{ required: true }}` makes the input required
(and adds the label `*`) unless `required` is passed explicitly — then
the top-level prop wins. The same holds for `readOnly`, `disabled`,
`type` and `rows`. Exceptions: `aria-describedby` is merged (the field's
own ids first), and an `onInput` handler is called after the
component's own.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` / `<textarea>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: label
props.description:
Field label; rendered with a trailing `*` when `required`.

Accepts rich content (text, emphasis, a small icon) — keep it short and
on one line, as m3 asks: the label is a single line (truncated with an
ellipsis), clicks on it go to the field, and the outlined notch draws a
hidden copy of it to measure its width. So no links or buttons in the
label, and no elements with an `id`.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Label position. `'floating'` keeps the label inside the container (it
rests in the input line and minimizes on focus or value; the outlined
variant notches the border). `'above'` draws it minimized above the
container — no notch — and the field lays out like a label-less one
(Compose `TextFieldLabelPosition.Above`).

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Native input `maxLength`; also shows a `length / maxLength` counter in the supporting line.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Render a `<textarea>` that auto-grows with its content.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input `name`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Blur handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native input `placeholder`.

props.name: prefixText
props.description: Static text before the input value (e.g. currency symbol).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Native input `readOnly`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input required and appends `*` to the label.

props.name: rows
props.description: Initial visible rows of the `multiline` textarea.

props.name: shrinkLabel
props.description:
Keep the floating label minimized even while the field is empty and
unfocused, so the placeholder and prefix / suffix show alongside it
(Compose `Inside` / `Cutout(isAlwaysMinimized = true)`; MUI's `shrink`).
No effect with `labelPlacement="above"`, which is always minimized.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the field (decorative).

props.name: suffixText
props.description: Static text after the input value (e.g. unit).

props.name: supportingText
props.description:
Helper line below the field. Replaced by `errorText` while in error.
Accepts rich content — a short link is fine (it stays reachable and is
part of the field's description via `aria-describedby`); keep it to
about one line, as m3 asks.

props.name: tonal
props.description:
Expressive tonal style (Compose `TextFieldDefaults.tonalColors()` /
`OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.tonalColors()` with `roundedShape`): a 12dp
rounded container, no active indicator on `filled` (surface-container
fill, error-container in error) and an outline-variant border on
`outlined` (transparent container, label inside the container rather than
notched into the border). The focused label stays on-surface-variant.
@experimental Compose still marks these values
`TODO(b/448727879)` (pending real tokens), so the look may change in a
minor release when the spec settles.

props.name: type
props.description:
Native input `type` (single-line only). For a password field (Compose
`SecureTextField`) use `type="password"` with an `autoComplete` of
`"current-password"` / `"new-password"`, and put a show / hide toggle in
`endIcon`: an `IconButton variant="standard" toggle` labelled
"Show password" (the label stays fixed; `aria-pressed` carries the
state) that switches `type` between `'password'` and `'text'`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container style.

TimePicker.description:
Material Design 3 Time picker (dial + input).

SurfaceContainerHigh surface with hour/minute selector fields (PrimaryContainer
when active), an AM/PM toggle (TertiaryContainer selected), and either a 256dp
SurfaceContainerHighest clock dial with a Primary selector, or editable input
fields — toggled with the keyboard/clock button, per Compose TimePickerTokens.

The dial follows Compose `ClockFace` / `ClockText`: tap a number or drag the
selector track (1-minute resolution while dragging); choosing an hour with a
pointer switches to minutes. The dial is one Tab stop (the selected number);
arrow keys move around the ring and Enter / Space selects. The hour / minute
selectors and AM / PM are radio groups. With `ampm={false}` (or a 24-hour
`locale`) the dial has an inner 12–23 ring and there is no AM / PM.

Input mode validates like Compose `TimeInput`: 2 digits max, out-of-range
text shows an error and is not committed, and an empty / invalid field
reverts to the current value on blur. `onChange` only ever receives valid
values.

`mode="scroll"` shows two endless scroll wheels (Compose `TimeScroll`,
built on {@link ScrollField}); its toggle switches scroll ⇄ input.
`variant="vibrant"` is the Expressive style (Compose `vibrantColors()`,
`TimePickerShapes`, `VibrantTimePickerDialog`), and
`orientation="horizontal"` puts the dial beside the time display.

`onAccept` / `onCancel` add the "Select time" headline and Cancel / OK
(Compose `TimePickerDialog`), with draft / commit semantics; `open` shows
the picker as a modal dialog that reports `onClose(reason)`.

props.name: ampm
props.description:
12-hour clock with AM / PM (`true`) or 24-hour clock (`false`).
Defaults to LocaleProvider `ampm`, else the `locale`'s hour cycle.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Uncontrolled initial display mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: getErrorLabel
props.defaultValue: 'Hour must be 1–12' / 'Hour must be 0–23' / 'Minute must be 0–59'
props.description: Input-mode error for an out-of-range field.

props.name: getHourLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of an hour on the dial and of the hour selector's value.
Receives the displayed hour (1–12 with AM/PM, 0–23 without).

props.name: getMinuteLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a minute on the dial and of the minute selector's value.

props.name: hourLabel
props.description: Name of the hour input / dial and its supporting text.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale whose hour cycle sets the default `ampm`.

props.name: minuteLabel
props.description: Name of the minute input / dial and its supporting text.

props.name: mode
props.description:
Display mode: clock `dial` or keyboard `input`. Controlled when
`onModeChange` is also passed.
@deprecated Passing `mode` **without** `onModeChange` keeps the v1.0
behavior — it only sets the initial mode and the toggle still switches.
Use `defaultMode` for that; in v2 `mode` will always be controlled.

props.name: onAccept
props.description:
OK (or Enter in the minute field) commits the draft. Passing `onAccept`,
`onCancel` or `open` adds the headline and the Cancel / OK row.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
Cancel, Escape or a scrim click: the value reverts (through `onChange`)
to what it was when the picker opened or was last accepted.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the new value on every change — with the action row this is
the draft; `onAccept` commits.

props.name: onClose
props.description: A modal picker asks to close, with the reason.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Fires when the toggle switches the display mode.

props.name: open
props.description:
Show the picker as a modal dialog (scrim, focus trap, Escape) — the
Compose `TimePickerDialog` equivalent. Renders nothing while `false`.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Dial layout: time display above the dial (`vertical`) or beside it
(`horizontal`, for landscape / short containers). The input and scroll
modes have a single layout.

props.name: periodLabel
props.description: Name of the AM / PM group.

props.name: selectHourLabel
props.description: Name of the hour selector.

props.name: selectMinuteLabel
props.description: Name of the minute selector.

props.name: showModeToggle
props.description:
Show the mode toggle: dial ⇄ input, or scroll ⇄ input when the picker
started in (or was switched to) `scroll` mode.

props.name: switchToDialLabel
props.description: Name of the toggle while showing the text input.

props.name: switchToInputLabel
props.description: Name of the toggle while showing the dial.

props.name: switchToScrollLabel
props.description: Name of the toggle while showing the text input after scroll mode.

props.name: titleLabel
props.description: Headline.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style. `vibrant` is the Expressive style: SurfaceContainer
container, larger SurfaceContainerLowest time fields with a Primary
selection, pill AM / PM toggles and a SurfaceContainerLowest dial.

Toolbar.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Toolbar — a container of action slots.

`docked` renders a full-width 64dp bar (SurfaceContainer / PrimaryContainer),
items centered 32dp apart (shrinking to 4dp when tight) inside a 16dp outside
padding. `floating` renders a rounded, elevated 64dp pill (CornerFull) with 8dp
inner padding and 4dp gaps that can flow horizontally or vertically — per
m3.material.io / Compose FloatingToolbarTokens. Each `IconButton` item takes a
48dp slot; standard `IconButton`s pick up the scheme's content colors
(standard: OnSurfaceVariant, selected SecondaryContainer / OnSecondaryContainer;
vibrant: OnPrimaryContainer, selected SurfaceContainer / OnSurface).

Keyboard: every item stays in the Tab order, and the arrow keys also move
between items — Left / Right (mirrored in RTL) for a horizontal toolbar,
Up / Down for a vertical one, Home / End to the ends; disabled items are
skipped and text fields keep their own arrow keys. Give the toolbar an
`aria-label` (recommended when a page has several toolbars).

Scrolling / collapsing (docs/decisions/phase-b-api.md B25): state props
(`expanded` / `defaultExpanded` / `onExpandedChange`, `hidden`) plus the
convenience `scrollBehavior` + `scrollTarget`. The expand / collapse motion
uses the FastSpatial spring (Compose `expand/shrinkHorizontally`).

props.name: children
props.description: Slots — usually icon buttons, buttons, or text fields. Always shown.

props.name: color
props.description: Color scheme.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial `expanded` when uncontrolled.

props.name: disableElevation
props.description:
Floating: removes the container shadow. m3 toolbars guidelines: "The
elevation on floating toolbars can be removed if on a visually distinct
background" — keep it when the toolbar floats over content (the Fab
`disableElevation` prop). A docked toolbar has no elevation either way.

props.name: endContent
props.description:
Floating: items after `children` that are shown only while `expanded`
(Compose `trailingContent`). On a docked toolbar they are plain items.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Floating: whether `startContent` / `endContent` are shown (controlled).
Collapsed content is `inert`. A floating toolbar with no `children`
collapses away entirely — pair it with a separate FAB for the m3
"floating toolbar with FAB" pattern (grow the FAB to `size="medium"`,
80dp, while collapsed).

props.name: hidden
props.description:
State: slides the toolbar off the screen edge (see `scrollBehavior`) and
makes it `inert`. Unlike the native `hidden` attribute it keeps its
layout box. Overrides `scrollBehavior="exitAlways"`.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when `expanded` should change (e.g. by `scrollBehavior="collapse"`).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Item flow direction (floating only).

props.name: scrollBehavior
props.description:
Observe `scrollTarget` and hide / collapse the toolbar automatically. A
docked toolbar becomes `position: sticky; bottom: 0`; position a floating
one yourself (e.g. `position: fixed`, 16dp from the edge). Leave it unset
to keep every control on screen — e.g. for assistive-technology users
(Compose disables these behaviors while TalkBack is on). Motion is
instant under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

props.name: scrollTarget
props.description: The scroll container observed by `scrollBehavior`.

props.name: startContent
props.description:
Floating: items before `children` that are shown only while `expanded`
(Compose `leadingContent`). On a docked toolbar they are plain items.

props.name: variant
props.description: Docked (full-width bar) or floating (rounded, elevated).

props.name: action
props.description:
Rich tooltip action(s) — up to two text buttons, laid out side by side.
A rich tooltip with an action becomes a non-modal `role="dialog"` whose
actions are reachable with Tab from the trigger; consider `persistent`.

props.name: caret
props.description:
Draw a caret (16×8dp triangle) pointing at the trigger, on the side of
the tooltip that faces it.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element (a single focusable/hoverable element).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial visibility.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when visibility should change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility.

props.name: persistent
props.description:
Persistent rich tooltip: opens and closes on click / tap of the trigger
(hover, focus and long-press don't open it) and stays open until the user
interacts elsewhere (outside press, Escape, or focus leaving the trigger
and tooltip). Recommended when the tooltip has an `action`; avoid it on
icon buttons.

props.name: placement
props.defaultValue: 'top' for plain, bottom-end corner for rich
props.description:
Preferred placement relative to the trigger: `'top'` / `'bottom'`
(centered on the trigger) or beside it — `'start'` / `'end'` (mirrored
in RTL) or `'left'` / `'right'` (vertically centered). The tooltip flips
to the opposite side when there is no room and is kept inside the
viewport. Inside a top app bar, use `'bottom'`.

When omitted, a plain tooltip goes above its trigger; a rich tooltip goes
to the trigger's bottom-end corner (below, extending toward the end
edge) and moves to whichever of the four corners keeps it on screen.

props.name: subhead
props.description: Rich tooltip subhead (title).

props.name: text
props.description: Body / supporting text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain style or rich (with subhead + action).
